title: Phone Number Range
description: Details of a phone number range.

id.description: Unique identifier of the phone number range.

start.description: The starting phone number in a range.

countryCode.description: The country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

voiceAccountGuid.description: Unique identifier of the Voice Account.

validFrom.description: Date and time the range is assigned to, and in use by the Voice Account.

validTo.description: Date and time the range is no longer assigned to, nor in use by the Voice Account.

orderId.description: Unique identifier of the order in which the range was requested.
